newsitem.title: CANADA: Oops, Canada's U.S. embassy predicts Chretien win.
newsitem.headline: Oops, Canada's U.S. embassy predicts Chretien win.

text.p: As far as the Canadian embassy in Washington is concerned, Prime Minister Jean Chretien's re-election seems assured.
The embassy wrote a news release, distributed by the prime minister's office in Ottawa on Monday, headlined: "Prime Minister Chretien to attend Denver Summit of the Eight, June 20-22, 1997."
The trouble is, voters will be deciding who will be Canada's leader on June 2 -- although Chretien is in fact well ahead in the polls.

The release was written by an embassy press officer on Friday, before Chretien called the election on Sunday. But it was sent to the prime minister's office only today and distributed on Monday afternoon.
"There is no assumption there at all (about the outcome)," embassy spokeswoman Pamela Chappell said by telephone.
